title: Neighbor Index Cascade
instructions: Trace the nested loops, break/continue branches, and list indices. Enter the exact stdout in order.
code:
items = [3, 1, 4, 2]
for outer in range(3):
    picked = 0
    for inner in range(outer, len(items)):
        if items[inner] % 2 == 0:
            picked = inner
            break
        items[inner] += 1
    items[outer] += picked
    print(outer, picked, items[outer])
print(items)
explanation: Each inner loop mutates odd elements before it reaches an even value. The selected index is added to the current outer element.

title: First Smaller Candidate
instructions: Trace the nested loops, break/continue branches, and list indices. Enter the exact stdout in order.
code:
left = [6, 3, 5]
right = [7, 2, 4, 1]
locations = []
for i, target in enumerate(left):
    choice = None
    for j in range(len(right)):
        if j % 2 == 0:
            continue
        if right[j] < target:
            choice = j
            break
    locations.append(choice)
    print(i, choice)
print("used", len(set(locations)))
explanation: Only odd column indices are checked, so all three left values select right[1] = 2.
